decisions.quote: we carried out a DLS analysis in a 10 mM NaCl solution on freeze-dried samples.
decisions.location: Results and Discussion; Table 2 (After Freeze-Drying/NaCl 10 mM); Table 1 medium not stated

decisions.quote: Zeta potential measurements were performed by electrophoresis measurements, in bidistilled water or 10 mM NaCl aqueous solution, at 25 °C using the same apparatus.
